assessments.reasoning: The complete SPDX detail reports SHA-256 926a380bf113098ca853c204362a911f390383c67cedfd2b06603a47ee07de71, licenseId CC-BY-NC-2.5, name Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 2.5 Generic and isDeprecatedLicenseId false. crossRef and seeAlso cite /licenses/by-nc/2.5/legalcode on creativecommons.org.
The SPDX data repository's unsigned annotated v3.29.0 tag targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, the commit in the BY-NC detail URL.
The publisher capture at the cited URL matches the scoped digest and identifies the English Generic BY-NC 2.5 text. Its clause boundaries limit the comparison described above.

challenge.method: Compared section 1 definitions and section 4 lettering in the pinned detail with the cited HTML, and tested whether the citation selects BY-NC-SA.
challenge.results: SPDX places Original Author in 1(c) with Licensor and begins 4(b) at the sublicensing sentence. CC gives Original Author a separate item and begins 4(b) with the commercial-advantage language. Both identify BY-NC 2.5 and the citation contains no SA component.

limitations: The generated and publisher texts have different clause boundaries. This finding covers the citation and identity only. Legal equivalence and consequences for downstream works remain outside scope.
